step_pairs.previous_step_result: Research confirmed PHP/8.1.0-dev contains a backdoor that was inserted when hackers breached the PHP source repository in March 2021. The backdoor in zlib.c file checks for malformed HTTP header User-Agentt (with double t) starting with the string zerodium. Any code following the zerodium string is executed as PHP code enabling remote code execution
